source: Sanan Optoelectronics investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-11-2026)

players.product: Vertically integrated SiC substrates, epitaxy and power chips (Hunan Sanan 6-inch and 8-inch SiC lines, GaN-on-Si); 8-inch SiC substrates from Chongqing Sanan for the Anyifa 8-inch SiC epitaxy and chip joint venture

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SSE e-Interactive: Hunan Sanan has 6-inch SiC capacity of 16,000 wafers a month, 8-inch SiC capacity of 1,000 wafers a month and GaN-on-silicon capacity of 2,000 wafers a month. In H1 2026 SiC line utilization was not high and the product-mix improvement was not yet complete; the company will accelerate expansion of SiC and other integrated-circuit businesses to raise utilization, sales and profitability.
quarterly_data.figure: 6-inch SiC 16,000 wafers/month; 8-inch SiC 1,000 wafers/month; GaN-on-Si 2,000 wafers/month

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chongqing Sanan has 8-inch SiC substrate capacity of 60,000 wafers a year and is expanding further to meet the SiC substrate demand of Anyifa. Anyifa has existing 8-inch epitaxy and chip capacity of 104,000 wafers a year and planned capacity of 480,000 wafers a year at full ramp; it has sampled 39 products, 4 of which have passed customer validation.
quarterly_data.figure: Chongqing 8-inch substrate 6 ten-thousand wafers/year; Anyifa 8-inch epi/chip 10.40 ten-thousand wafers/year now, 48 ten-thousand planned; 39 products sampled, 4 qualified

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Optical-grade SiC substrates: 8-inch is in small-batch supply and 12-inch has been sampled to leading industry customers for validation.

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Optical chips for data communication: the company offers 70mW/100mW/150mW/200mW CW light sources, 100G VCSEL, 100G/200G EML and 100G/200G PD chips for optical modules. It works with 4 of the global top-10 optical-module makers: chips for 400G/800G modules are in volume shipment at 2 of them, chips for 800G/1.6T modules are sampling at the other 2, and chips for 3.2T modules are in R&D.
quarterly_data.figure: 4 of the top-10 module makers; 2 in volume (400G/800G), 2 sampling (800G/1.6T); 3.2T in R&D

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Optical capacity: epitaxy capacity is 6,000 wafers a month and optical-chip capacity 2,750 wafers a month. Because AI optical-module demand has surged and the high-speed chip market is in tight supply, the company plans to expand optical-chip capacity to 4,500 wafers a month; the ordered equipment will start arriving from Q4.
quarterly_data.figure: epitaxy 6,000 wafers/month; optical chips 2,750 wafers/month, expanding to 4,500 wafers/month; equipment from Q4

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Since 2026 the company has raised prices of some LED chips, RF chips, power-electronics chips and optical chips to offset higher prices of precious metals, substrates and other raw materials.

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Subsidiary results, H1 2026: Quanzhou Sanan Optical Communication (optical business) revenue RMB 115 million, up 64.67%, net loss RMB 179,200, improved 99.62%; Quanzhou Sanan Integrated Circuit (filters) revenue RMB 230 million, down 0.26%, net loss RMB 118 million, improved 26.19%. The year-over-year decline in group H1 revenue is mainly because precious-metal scrap (gold from November 1, 2025, platinum from January 1, 2026) is now refined on a toll basis and swapped in kind instead of sold, so the recovery is no longer booked as other revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: optical subsidiary revenue RMB 1.15 hundred million (+64.67%), net profit RMB -17.92 ten-thousand; filter subsidiary revenue RMB 2.30 hundred million (-0.26%), net profit RMB -1.18 hundred million

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Thermal materials: the company supplies heat-dissipation substrates in small batches to several customers and polycrystalline diamond polished wafers in small batches for high-power device cooling; diamond capacity is small and not yet at scale. Its wholly owned Quanzhou Sanan holds 45% of the Xinying Display joint venture with TCL CSOT, which develops glass-based Micro LED products.

Sanan Optoelectronics.why: Makes SiC substrates, epitaxy and power chips (Hunan Sanan) and supplies 8-inch SiC substrates to its Anyifa SiC joint venture; SiC power devices go into data-center / AI server power supplies, EV and storage.
Sanan Optoelectronics.evidence: Sanan Optoelectronics investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-11-2026): Hunan Sanan has 6-inch SiC capacity of 16,000 wafers/month and 8-inch 1,000 wafers/month; Chongqing Sanan's 8-inch SiC substrate capacity of 60,000 wafers/year is expanding to meet Anyifa's substrate demand.
